# 00000004591

**English.** Definition: The Selberg zeta function is the zeta function generated by prime geodesics. Conjecture: For a general surface of genus g the expected real part of the first zero is of the explicit type one quarter, the variance is controlled by the affine spectral gap, and it obeys a random-matrix-type distribution. (random-matrix law of the Selberg first zero)

**中文。** 定义：Selberg zeta 指素测地线生成的 zeta 函数。猜想：亏格一般曲面的首零实部期望为四分之一型显式,方差由仿射谱间隙控制且服从随机矩阵型分布。（Selberg 首零随机矩阵律）
